limitations: FLACAP repeatedly returns 0x0010 (16KiB per RM), while SKU/database/manual specify 64KiB; capacity mismatch is unresolved. Successful range reads do not independently establish physical capacity.
ChipInfo returns no capacity/UID; M030 identification and electronic signature use family-specific addresses.
0x1ffff000..0x1ffff1ff is user-defined nonvolatile information, not a factory BOOT program. boot.bin is an initial filename alias for user-info.bin.
RAM/peripheral/register reads are sequential snapshots with debug access effects.
Successful CSR/DMI reads do not prove implementation of every probed address.
Current CLI has no family mapping for 0x8e, and Flash programming/loader operation has not been tested.
